source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The E2E include loads colors.css and variables.css, while accountManage.css imports icons.css. Arrow controls use navigation icon tokens and separate button hover/active backgrounds; the OpenPGP more-menu dropmarker uses the shared icon with currentColor stroke and explicit appearance/display values. These are concrete stylesheet dependencies and state selectors. Resolved colors, focus, contrast and native rendering were not tested. In retained [D302371](https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D302371), reviewers request the shared include imports and icon variables; the owned source adopts those changes and the separately proposed appearance adjustment. Reported macOS retesting remains historical; Done marks alone are not the adoption proof.
title: E2E account settings load the shared tokens used by their arrow and menu controls
